note: The first line is reader-facing caption. The second line is an explicit screenshot/GIF creation brief. Final image and GIF files are not yet captured.

slots.caption: Hue lives alongside the Blueprint graph, giving compatible selected nodes a dedicated styling panel.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture UE 5.8 Blueprint Editor with graph, selected Call Function node, docked Hue tab, and Instance/Category/Global headings readable.
slots.alt: Hue lives alongside the Blueprint graph, giving compatible selected nodes a dedicated styling panel.

slots.caption: Header, title, body and compatible labels can each receive their own color.
slots.capture_instructions: Show one normal supported node with clearly differentiated Header Color, Header Text Color, Body Color and Body Text Color; annotate the four actual surfaces.
slots.alt: Header, title, body and compatible labels can each receive their own color.

slots.caption: Nested My Blueprint categories let related members share parent styles without copying values.
slots.capture_instructions: Show My Blueprint Combat, Combat|Weapons and Combat|Weapons|Melee with matching graph nodes; label parent and inherited colors.
slots.alt: Nested My Blueprint categories let related members share parent styles without copying values.

slots.caption: Hue's panel and node context menu provide complementary ways to apply the same style rules.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a selected function node, Hue panel and open right-click Hue submenu without obscuring important controls.
slots.alt: Hue's panel and node context menu provide complementary ways to apply the same style rules.

slots.caption: Hue separates the rules that choose colors from the native Slate surfaces that display them.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a diagram of HueModule, HueStyleResolver, SHuePanel, HueMenu, HueNodeFactory, HuePinFactory, HueNativeNodeDecorator and Blueprint/config storage.
slots.alt: Hue separates the rules that choose colors from the native Slate surfaces that display them.

slots.caption: Effective-source labels identify why a selected node has its current color.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture one selected node with two Hue channel rows showing distinct sources such as Override and Parent Category, with the node visible.
slots.alt: Effective-source labels identify why a selected node has its current color.

slots.caption: A consistent palette can make movement, combat and UI logic easier to recognize at a glance.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a nontrivial but readable Blueprint with movement nodes blue, combat nodes red and UI helpers purple; leave pin connections and labels visible.
slots.alt: A consistent palette can make movement, combat and UI logic easier to recognize at a glance.

slots.caption: Hue installs as a normal Editor plugin under the Unreal project's Plugins directory.
slots.capture_instructions: Show Explorer at YourProject/Plugins/Hue with Hue.uplugin, Source, Resources and Config visible; avoid any nested duplicate Hue folder.
slots.alt: Hue installs as a normal Editor plugin under the Unreal project's Plugins directory.

slots.caption: A single Instance override changes only the selected node, then clears back to its inherited appearance.
slots.capture_instructions: Record selecting a Call Function node, opening the Hue panel, setting Instance Header Color in the native picker, then clearing it with another call to the same function visible.
slots.alt: A single Instance override changes only the selected node, then clears back to its inherited appearance.

slots.caption: The four visual channels target separate regions of a supported node.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a standard node styled with red header, white title text, dark blue body and yellow body labels; label each region without covering the node.
slots.alt: The four visual channels target separate regions of a supported node.

slots.caption: The same node can have Instance, Category and Global style sources with different reach.
slots.capture_instructions: Select a node with an actual My Blueprint Category and applicable Global Function identity, then capture all three Hue scope headers and source states.
slots.alt: The same node can have Instance, Category and Global style sources with different reach.

slots.caption: A node's channels can resolve from different scopes at the same time.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture the Hue panel with Header Color sourced from Category, Body Color from Global and Body Text Color from Instance; show the styled node beside it.
slots.alt: A node's channels can resolve from different scopes at the same time.

slots.caption: Clearing a specific color reveals the next applicable inherited rule without affecting other channels.
slots.capture_instructions: Record Header Color set at Global, Category and Instance; clear Instance, then Category, then Global, showing each effective color/source change.
slots.alt: Clearing a specific color reveals the next applicable inherited rule without affecting other channels.

slots.caption: Hue's Category scope follows a member's actual My Blueprint Category.
slots.capture_instructions: Show a Blueprint's My Blueprint panel with a custom function assigned to Combat, its call node selected in the graph and the Hue Category section active.
slots.alt: Hue's Category scope follows a member's actual My Blueprint Category.

slots.caption: A child Category inherits the closest parent style for each individual channel.
slots.capture_instructions: Show Combat and Combat|Weapons/Combat|Weapons|Melee member nodes with Header Color inherited from the nearest parent and Body Color inherited from the higher parent.
slots.alt: A child Category inherits the closest parent style for each individual channel.

slots.caption: Renaming an actual Category can preserve its associated Hue styling throughout its hierarchy.
slots.capture_instructions: Record styled parent and child My Blueprint categories, rename the parent, and show both graph nodes retaining colors and updated source labels.
slots.alt: Renaming an actual Category can preserve its associated Hue styling throughout its hierarchy.

slots.caption: The Hue panel exposes channel swatches, available scopes, clearing tools and source reporting.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture the full docked Hue panel beside a selected compatible function node, showing all four channel rows and Instance/Category/Global scopes.
slots.alt: The Hue panel exposes channel swatches, available scopes, clearing tools and source reporting.

slots.caption: The Hue submenu offers scope-specific styling without requiring the docked panel.
slots.capture_instructions: Right-click a node with Instance, Category and Global Function identities; capture the expanded Hue submenu with scope labels and channel commands.
slots.alt: The Hue submenu offers scope-specific styling without requiring the docked panel.

slots.caption: Hue reports mixed values and eligible target counts across a Blueprint graph selection.
slots.capture_instructions: Select at least four supported node types, with different current colors, and show the Hue panel displaying Multiple Values and target counts.
slots.alt: Hue reports mixed values and eligible target counts across a Blueprint graph selection.

slots.caption: Compatible nodes can be recolored while unsupported or specialized native interfaces remain safe.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a Hue-styled function call beside a reroute and Documentation node, including their different visible appearances and an unsupported indication.
slots.alt: Compatible nodes can be recolored while unsupported or specialized native interfaces remain safe.

slots.caption: Hue uses the correct visual integration path for each supported Blueprint node family.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw two paths: Hue custom SGraphNode wrapper for an ordinary node, and native widget decoration for specialized presentations, both fed by one style resolver.
slots.alt: Hue uses the correct visual integration path for each supported Blueprint node family.

slots.caption: Instance and Category rules live with Blueprints, while Global rules are stored in project editor configuration.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a three-column ownership diagram showing node GUID → owning Blueprint, category key → defining Blueprint, and typed global identity → Hue Editor config.
slots.alt: Instance and Category rules live with Blueprints, while Global rules are stored in project editor configuration.

slots.caption: Global styling groups nodes by logical identity rather than matching the text displayed on screen.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture Get and Set nodes for the same member variable sharing Global Variable style, with a different variable showing another identity.
slots.alt: Global styling groups nodes by logical identity rather than matching the text displayed on screen.

slots.caption: Hue keeps Unreal's native editable node controls usable while tinting supported presentation surfaces.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a supported specialized node with a tinted header/body plus its normal numeric, class or object picker intact; use a legible zoom.
slots.alt: Hue keeps Unreal's native editable node controls usable while tinting supported presentation surfaces.

slots.caption: A color may remain after clearing because an inherited Category or Global rule still applies.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture the Hue panel immediately after clearing an Instance Header Color, showing a visible Category/Global source label and the inherited node color.
slots.alt: A color may remain after clearing because an inherited Category or Global rule still applies.

slots.caption: Unavailable scopes distinguish unsupported nodes from missing Category or Global identities.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture an intentionally unsupported Documentation or reroute node selected beside a supported node, with the Hue panel's unavailable/unsupported state readable.
slots.alt: Unavailable scopes distinguish unsupported nodes from missing Category or Global identities.

slots.caption: Updating a manual Hue installation means replacing the complete plugin directory with a compatible release.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture Hue.uplugin directly beneath Plugins/Hue in File Explorer, with Source, Resources and Config shown; optionally label the matching release version.
slots.alt: Updating a manual Hue installation means replacing the complete plugin directory with a compatible release.

slots.caption: Hue runs only in the editor, connecting graph styling to Blueprint-owned rules and project configuration.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw a conceptual flow from selected K2 node to Scope/Identity resolver, stored style overrides and Slate node presentation, with no runtime link.
slots.alt: Hue runs only in the editor, connecting graph styling to Blueprint-owned rules and project configuration.

slots.caption: Each Hue channel is stored and resolved separately before being applied to compatible Slate surfaces.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram the four FHueNodeStyleOverride flags and FLinearColor values feeding the corresponding node header/text/body/pin-label surfaces.
slots.alt: Each Hue channel is stored and resolved separately before being applied to compatible Slate surfaces.

slots.caption: Hue resolves each visual channel through a predictable precedence chain.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a top-to-bottom flowchart Instance → exact Category → nearest parents → Global → Unreal Default, with an independent channel lookup label.
slots.alt: Hue resolves each visual channel through a predictable precedence chain.

slots.caption: Category styles are stored on the Blueprint defining the relevant member.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram a function call in one Blueprint referencing a member defined in another, and show CategoryStyles being read from the defining Blueprint.
slots.alt: Category styles are stored on the Blueprint defining the relevant member.

slots.caption: Category rename migration runs on Blueprint change events rather than on every graph paint.
slots.capture_instructions: Create an event flow Blueprint changed/compiled → captured member category fingerprints → rename detection → CategoryStyles key migration → Slate invalidation.
slots.alt: Category rename migration runs on Blueprint change events rather than on every graph paint.

slots.caption: Hue deduplicates matching Category or Global targets before applying one transaction.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw five selected nodes collapsing into three unique category/global identities and one FScopedTransaction, while unsupported nodes are skipped.
slots.alt: Hue deduplicates matching Category or Global targets before applying one transaction.

slots.caption: Hue persists node GUID, category path and typed global identity overrides in different data owners.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram InstanceStyles: FGuid, CategoryStyles: FString on UHueBlueprintExtension, and GlobalFunctionStyles on UHueSettings, with save ownership.
slots.alt: Hue persists node GUID, category path and typed global identity overrides in different data owners.

slots.caption: Native-safe coloring affects selected Slate surfaces without replacing unrelated controls.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram HueNodeFactory, HuePinFactory and HueNativeNodeDecorator attaching color attributes to valid SGraphNode/SGraphPin surfaces, leaving editable controls intact.
slots.alt: Native-safe coloring affects selected Slate surfaces without replacing unrelated controls.

slots.caption: Changing a more specific rule instantly reveals the lower-precedence color underneath.
slots.capture_instructions: Record one node with a Global Header, then a Category Header, then an Instance Header; clear each in reverse order with the Hue panel source label visible.
slots.alt: Changing a more specific rule instantly reveals the lower-precedence color underneath.

slots.caption: Closer Category overrides supersede a parent only for the channels they define.
slots.capture_instructions: Record styling Combat, then Combat|Weapons Header Color, then clearing the Weapons override; keep the My Blueprint hierarchy and relevant nodes in view.
slots.alt: Closer Category overrides supersede a parent only for the channels they define.

slots.caption: The native color picker updates the selected node's supported visual regions.
slots.capture_instructions: Record opening a Header Color picker in Hue, adjusting to a new color, applying, and using Unreal Undo; keep the selected node visible.
slots.alt: The native color picker updates the selected node's supported visual regions.

slots.caption: One Undo reverses an entire Hue batch edit on the eligible selection.
slots.capture_instructions: Record several differently colored supported nodes selected together, set Instance Body Color once, then Undo once and show all previous colors return.
slots.alt: One Undo reverses an entire Hue batch edit on the eligible selection.

slots.caption: Hue context actions apply through the same style system as the panel.
slots.capture_instructions: Record right-clicking a supported node, choosing Hue → Instance → Header Color, selecting a tint, and showing the matching change in the Hue panel.
slots.alt: Hue context actions apply through the same style system as the panel.

slots.caption: Changing Global affects matching identities while Instance changes only the local occurrence.
slots.capture_instructions: Record two uses of one function; apply Global Header Color to both, then override only one with Instance, then clear the Instance rule.
slots.alt: Changing Global affects matching identities while Instance changes only the local occurrence.

slots.caption: Moving one member to a new Category differs from renaming the Category itself.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a styled Combat category with two members; move only one member to Utility and show Combat keeps its original style while the moved member follows its new category.
slots.alt: Moving one member to a new Category differs from renaming the Category itself.

slots.caption: Hue v1.0.0 establishes the shipped visual styling foundation; later additions remain uncommitted.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a clear release timeline with v1.0.0 Released and a separate Future / Not Committed area. Do not invent version numbers, feature lists or dates.
slots.alt: Hue v1.0.0 establishes the shipped visual styling foundation; later additions remain uncommitted.
